call_sites: TransformerLayer._forward_mlp -> MoELayer.forward -> router/preprocess -> token_dispatch -> experts.forward -> token_combine
implementation_backend: TEGroupedMLP/TE grouped linear when enabled; SequentialMLP fallback otherwise; dispatchers add permutation and optional NCCL collectives

forward.path: router logits/top-k -> routing map/probs -> token dispatch/permutation -> expert fc1 grouped GEMM -> activation/SwiGLU -> expert fc2 grouped GEMM -> combine/unpermute
forward.grouped_gemm: expert compute only; routing and communication are separate stages

backward.path: autograd through dispatcher and expert module; TE grouped linear backward or per-expert linear backward
backward.communication: dispatcher backward reverses combine/dispatch and may involve collectives

dtypes: FP8/MXFP8 only on specific TE/CuTe paths

distributed_semantics.routing: top-k and capacity/drop policy determine grouping

v100_feasibility: SUPPORTED_WITH_FALLBACK: SequentialMLP and compatible FP16/BF16 paths; TE grouped GEMM/FP8/MXFP8 features require explicit V100 validation and may be unsupported
candidate_optimization_boundary: D/E: expert grouped GEMM may be isolated only with routing metadata fixed; full target includes multi-stage dispatch/compute/communication
open_questions: Exact dispatcher and experts implementation selected by final config
Whether grouped-GEMM dependency is installed on V100 backend
